stateOwner: one serialized surface owns the HWND swap chain, D3D11 immediate context, back buffer, presentation serial, terminal invalidation, and close state
threadContract: call synchronous resize, upload, draw, present, and close operations from one background presentation executor, never the Qt UI thread

invariants.initialization: device, immediate context, factory, shaders, constant buffer, and sampler are lazily created before the first swap chain
invariants.swapChain: the HWND owns one two-buffer B8G8R8A8 flip-discard swap chain with Alt+Enter disabled
invariants.resize: all direct and indirect back-buffer bindings are cleared and flushed before ResizeBuffers; invalid and unchanged dimensions do not mutate the surface
invariants.upload: one validated RGBA32-float frame is write-discard uploaded into one bounded texture and SRV reused until source dimensions change, with no frame queue
invariants.draw: one full-screen triangle letterboxes the source into the current surface and clears uncovered pixels to opaque black
invariants.present: one non-blocking Present call classifies success, occlusion, busy, unavailability, device loss, and failure without retry loops
invariants.cancellation: pre-requested cancellation refuses each expensive phase before it begins and never reports an unpresented frame as presented
invariants.terminal: device removal or reset permanently invalidates the instance; other unexpected HRESULT failures permanently fail it
invariants.close: close releases back-buffer references before swap-chain, context, device, and factory ownership and returns one stable closed receipt
